about: Every character the child pages can draw in Urdu, as code points only (no text). Checked by dashboard/tests/web-quiz-face-lite-storybooks.service.test.js against the light face wq-nastaliq-7.woff2.

storybooks.source: the storybook tables, read only, 2026-10-18: story_books with lang ur (36 books, all ready): title and author; story_pages of those books: text and the per-word text; story_questions of those books: the question and every option
storybooks.not_in_either_face_note: Latin punctuation, Latin digits and curly quotes in the book text. The full face (-6) has no glyph for them either and its unicode-range leaves them out, so with either face they are drawn by the next font in the stack. None of them is an Urdu letter or mark, and none joins.

ui.source: Urdu word runs (two or more letters) in dashboard/public/wq/*.js, dashboard/routes/web-quiz.routes.js, bot/shared/services/quiz/web-quiz*.js and story*.js; regex range ends left out
